prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "oskyldig". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "innocent".
Scene: A calm man in a courtroom as clear evidence points away from him, a symbolic cleared check mark, no readable legal documents.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "o- can mean not; skyldig = guilty; oskyldig = innocent.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Han är oskyldig till brottet.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
